observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console with a textured front panel and a PlayStation logo on the top right.
The console has visible scratches and scuffs on the front panel and sides, indicating use.
The console is placed on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' and 'No 1 Online Gadget Store' printed on it.
In the background, shelves are filled with boxed electronics, including smartphones and accessories.
No controller or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not a Pro, based on the size and design.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: The console in the photos is a standard PS4, not a PS4 Pro. The PS4 Pro is larger and has a different design. The seller's claim of 'PS4 Pro' is not supported by the visual evidence.
No controller is visible in either photo. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the controller with visible buttons, ports, and condition.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI port, power supply)
risks.proof: Close-up of the disc drive, HDMI port, and power connector, showing no damage or corrosion.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photo of the controller included with the console.
Close-up of the disc drive, HDMI port, and power connector.
Photo of the console's serial number and any labels or stickers.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
